intro.title: Build generic data table props API
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a generic props API for a data table component using TypeScript. You'll learn how to use generics to create flexible, type-safe components that can work with any data shape. The main constructs involved are TypeScript generics, interfaces, and type parameters. By the end, you'll have a reusable table component that maintains full type safety for different datasets.
intro.usecase: Generic data table props APIs are essential in enterprise dashboards and admin panels where developers need to display various datasets with consistent UI patterns. For example, an e-commerce analytics dashboard might show customer data, product inventories, and sales reports—all using the same table component with different column definitions and data types. This pattern allows developers to create reusable table components that can handle user data, financial transactions, or inventory items while maintaining type safety across different views. By implementing this API, you can build a single flexible table component instead of creating separate tables for each data type, significantly reducing code duplication in data-intensive applications.
